description: Converse directly with Sentinel, SocialWTF's in-house autonomous AI assistant running on SocialWTF's own model infrastructure with zero outside API costs. Sentinel can search the full digital products catalog, discover music tracks and audio stems, search public posts and creator profiles, compare product prices, draft posts, and report live roadmap and platform architecture updates. Works both with and without a local SocialWTF account (automatically attaches your session token if registered). Unlike socialwtf_message (which sends DMs to connected peers), this talks to the platform's built-in Sentinel AI.

prompt.description: Question or instruction for Sentinel AI (1-2000 characters, e.g. 'Search for music stems and summarize the latest SocialWTF roadmap updates').

name: socialwtf_sentinel_chat

actions.description: Suggested UI/navigation actions returned by Sentinel.

toolCalls.description: In-house Sentinel tools invoked during reasoning.

modelProvider.description: In-house SocialWTF model provider that generated the response.

success.description: True when Sentinel processed the conversation turn.

toolResults.description: Structured outputs from Sentinel's internal tool executions.

title: Ask Sentinel (SocialWTF In-House AI Assistant)
